opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow); Postgraduate, Full and Fellow applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at Society meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers registration and attendance at meeting dinners, with a contribution toward travel and accommodation. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings in one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: To support members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Physiological Society; applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: To support members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential, enhancing their commitment to physiology and benefiting the wider community of physiologists.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of The Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research.
